top_signals.title: Poland Probes Krakow Shooting as Terrorism
top_signals.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News reporter Piotr Skolimowski discusses the investigation into the deadly Krakow shooting and the far right ideology authorities say may have motivated the attack. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Skolimowski explains how the shooting comes amid heightened political tensions in Poland and growing divisions over the war in Ukraine. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: What America’s Factories Reveal About the Economy
top_signals.summary: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin traveled to Union, South Carolina, to hear directly from manufacturers about what is happening beneath the economic data. At auto-parts maker Gestamp, demand remains solid and investment continues, but businesses are navigating rising costs, changing technology and an uncertain policy environment, giving Barkin a ground-level view of the forces shaping the economy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
